OpenAI has officially launched **o3-mini**, the newest addition to its reasoning-first model family. Designed specifically for coding, STEM problem solving, and complex logic, o3-mini offers a compelling balance of high accuracy and reduced token latency.

### Key Capabilities and Speed Tiers

Unlike standard autoregressive models like GPT-4o, o3-mini utilizes internal chain-of-thought processing before providing an answer. OpenAI has made three distinct reasoning effort settings available:
- **Low**: Ideal for rapid code completions and quick logic validations.
- **Medium**: Balanced mode for standard algorithmic problems and technical debugging.
- **High**: Comprehensive analysis for challenging mathematics, multi-file code refactoring, and quantitative proofs.

| AIME 2024 (High School Olympiad) | 87.3% | 83.3% | 13.3% |

body:
DeepSeek has released **DeepSeek-V3**, a breakthrough 671-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that delivers frontier-grade performance on coding, mathematics, and multilingual reasoning at an unprecedented price point.

### Architectural Innovations & Token Pricing

Unlike monolithic architectures, DeepSeek-V3 activates only 37 billion parameters per token during inference. This design achieves state-of-the-art throughput while keeping token costs at:
- **Input Tokens**: $0.14 per 1M tokens (~PKR 39 per million tokens)
- **Output Tokens**: $0.28 per 1M tokens (~PKR 78 per million tokens)

In comparison, OpenAI GPT-4o costs $2.50 per 1M input tokens, making DeepSeek nearly **18 times more cost-effective** for high-volume automation.

### Benchmarks Comparison

| Benchmark | DeepSeek-V3 | GPT-4o | Claude 3.5 Sonnet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MMLU (General Knowledge) | 88.5% | 87.2% | 88.3% |
| HumanEval (Python Code) | 82.6% | 81.4% | 83.2% |
| MATH-500 (Complex Math) | 90.2% | 89.6% | 78.3% |

### Why This Matters for Pakistani Businesses

Most tech companies and digital agencies in Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad face two primary bottlenecks when deploying AI:
1. **International Card Declines**: Banks in Pakistan routinely flag or block recurring foreign SaaS payments to overseas AI providers.
2. **Withholding Tax**: Credit card statements in Pakistan carry up to 10% advance tax on foreign digital services.

By combining open models like DeepSeek-V3 with managed subscriptions and local payment methods via PakAITools, Pakistani engineering teams can build production AI agents without currency friction or credit card dependency.
